title: Nativity SVG Bundle, Christmas Silhouette Cut Files, Holy Family, Manger, Three Wise Men, Shepherd & Angel for Cricut (svg, dxf, png)
description:
Six original, reverent nativity silhouettes for Christmas: the Holy Family in the stable under the star, the manger with the newborn child, the three wise men on camels travelling to Bethlehem, the good shepherd with his flock, the Star of Bethlehem, and a herald angel with a trumpet. Classic, elegant shapes in the timeless tradition of the Christmas story, with no cartoon faces.

Each design is a single-layer, single-path cut file, so no slicing, welding or cleanup is needed. Every star, figure and animal is attached, so nothing falls out. Cut them from vinyl for windows, glass blocks, mugs and signs, from cardstock for Christmas cards and mantel scenes, from wood or acrylic on a laser for a tabletop nativity or ornaments, or from heat-transfer vinyl for shirts, totes and pillows.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 6 designs: Holy Family in the Stable, Manger Under the Star, Three Magi on Camels (wide framed panel), The Good Shepherd, Star of Bethlehem, Herald Angel
• SVG — Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Designer Edition, Inkscape, Illustrator
• DXF — Silhouette Studio Basic Edition, laser software (inches)
• PNG — 1800 px on the longest side, transparent background (6 in at 300 DPI)

SIZING TIP
Default size is 6 in on the longest side; resize freely with the proportions locked. We recommend 4 in or larger for vinyl, 5 in or larger for cardstock, heat-transfer vinyl and 3 mm laser-cut wood or acrylic, and 8 in wide or larger for the Three Magi panel. Do a test cut on a new material first.

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on up to 500 finished physical items per design. Please don't share or resell the digital files.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. Files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand for clean cuts.
